claims: NASA successfully launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II marks the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifted off from Kennedy Space Center.
The SLS rocket sent four astronauts on a 10-day mission to orbit the Moon.
Artemis II tests critical systems for future lunar landings.
Artemis II is a test flight, not a landing.
Artemis II is aimed at validating life-support systems with a crew on board before future surface landings.
The Artemis II mission includes NASA astronaut Reid Wiseman (commander).
The Artemis II mission includes NASA astronaut Victor Glover (pilot).
The Artemis II mission includes NASA astronaut Christina Koch (mission specialist).
The Artemis II mission includes CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to go beyond low Earth orbit since 1972.
Artemis II features the first Black man to fly to the Moon.
Artemis II features the first woman to fly to the Moon.
Artemis II features the first Canadian to fly to the Moon.
The Orion spacecraft is designed to perform a 10-day trip.
The Orion spacecraft's 10-day trip sets a record for the farthest distance traveled from Earth.
Ispace plans to use its new Apex 1.0 lander for a mission to the far side of the moon in 2026.
